Rules: Diagnose only: do not modify source files or run mutating commands.
Do not use cloud/cluster CLIs (kubectl, az, aws, snow); ask the orchestrator to delegate to the matching specialist.

CliTools.Name: dotnet
CliTools.UseCase: .NET SDK. Use `--nologo -v q` for build/test/restore to keep output terse. Always pass `--nologo -v q`; if one command fails, rerun only that command with `-v n` and filter with rg.

CliTools.Name: ilspycmd
CliTools.UseCase: Decompile .NET assemblies. Example: `ilspycmd -p assembly.dll`, `ilspycmd -t Namespace.Type assembly.dll`.

CliTools.Name: usql
CliTools.UseCase: Universal SQL CLI. Example: `usql "sqlite:///C:/data/app.db" -c "\dt"`. Output: `-J` JSON, `-C` CSV, `-t` rows only. SELECT only.

CliTools.Name: docker
CliTools.UseCase: Inspect only: `docker ps`, `docker logs --tail 200 <c>`, `docker inspect`, `docker images`. Never run, stop, remove or prune.
